==Notes==
{{bug|The portal on the first level claims it leads to the third level of [[Forsaken Tunnels]].}}
{{bug|Multiple groups of singed oaks fail to fight back.}}
* The dungeon can be entered with a party of 6 when starting from [[Yak's Bend]] or even 8 when starting from [[Temple of the Ages]] (''very'' far away).
* If any party members have [[Elegy for Those Left Behind]], the bandits that drop the [[Elemental Keystone]] don't spawn, so the party cannot advance to the second level.
* If no party members have [[The Dreamer and the Zealot]] active, the gate to the third level remains closed and none of the bosses on the third level spawn.
* First and second floor re-uses the second and third floor of [[Forsaken Tunnels]] with slight environmental differences.
* Because this area is mechanically part of the [[Depths of Tyria]], the [[Reforged Mode (effect)|Reforged Mode]] [[effect]] is not applied.

==Trivia==
* This dungeon was added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260428|April 28th, 2026]] update.
